paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging and a BLEU score for three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 26 to 34, with tick labels at integer values. A red dashed line with star-shaped markers represents “Consistency-Bi”, starting at approximately 27.5 at an average lagging of 0, increasing to 32.2 at an average lagging of 5.0, then up to 33.4 at an average lagging of 10.0. A blue dashed line with square markers represents “Inconsistency-CE”, beginning at 26.5 at an average lagging of 0, rising to 31.3 at an average lagging of 5.0, followed by a value of 31.8 at an average lagging of 10.0. A purple solid line with diamond markers representing “Inconsistency-CE-MP” starts at 26.5 at an average lagging of 0 and progresses to 30.8 at an average lagging of 5.0 and 31.3 at an average lagging of 10.0.
